verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a JavaScript UI framework consumed entirely as a code library. It has no product UI, such as a dashboard or console, whose actions an API would need to mirror. Asking for API/UI feature parity is therefore a category error for this kind of product. The missing OpenAPI spec (vue-probe-2) is not counted against it, because no hosted service or UI exists to expose.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
